name: 70739 · Greenwel Spgs, LA
findings: ZIP 70739 (Greenwel Spgs) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70739 (Greenwel Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
